notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {B/G}.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Lesser Masticore, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
